vetSays.line: A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.
A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.

🌱 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek looks over the garden: turned soil, nothing planted. A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek sowed bright red-orange oval fruits on arching thorny canes in the empty plot — seed gathered during garden duty.
📓 Journal: the person in their 30s, with a scarred cheek taught the man in his 50s, with a gap-toothed grin Animal Behavior.
A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek folds their arms. "Sure. Your call. For now."
A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek doesn't say a word. They just stand there, arms crossed, until you finish giving the order. The silence does the talking.
A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
...and then it lands: A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
🛡️ Michelle, Emilio, Jae-hyuk, Tariq and Aki met them at the door — 5 put down. Michelle, Emilio, Jae-hyuk, Tariq, Aki are hurt.
🛡️ Pearl, Emilio, Jae-hyuk and Aki met them at the door — 4 put down. Pearl, Emilio, Jae-hyuk, Aki are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Pearl, Emilio and Tariq met them at the door — 3 put down. Pearl, Emilio, Tariq are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nadia just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Michelle, Pearl and Emilio met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Pearl didn't come back. Michelle, Emilio are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? James just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Tariq, Aki, Nadia and James met them at the door — 4 put down. Tariq, Aki, James are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Hemi just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Victor, Petra and Hemi met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Victor, Petra, Hemi are hurt.
🛡️ Victor, Petra and Chantal met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Victor, Petra, Chantal are hurt.
🛡️ Victor and Petra met them at the door — 2 put down. Victor, Petra are hurt.
🛡️ James and Gerardo met them at the door — 2 put down. James, Gerardo are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
